cards.name: hero
cards.question: Instagram Font Generator
cards.qualifier: Type once, copy any of 30+ Unicode styles and paste them into your Instagram bio, name field, captions, Reels captions, comments and Story text.

cards.name: where-styled-text-works
cards.title: Where styled text works on Instagram

groups.label: Bio and name field
groups.text: Your bio allows 150 characters, and styled text pastes in fine.

groups.label: Captions and Reels captions
groups.text: Captions can be up to 2,200 characters.

groups.label: Stories
groups.text: Instagram's Story editor has its own built-in fonts.

cards.name: key-point
cards.kicker: Styles you can generate for Instagram
cards.quote: Instagram has no font menu for bios or captions, but it shows Unicode characters exactly as you paste them.
